# LibreOffice Writer GUI Interface Description

## Application Window

- **Title Bar**: Displays "nda_contract.odt - LibreOffice Writer"
- **System Tray**: Shows date and time "Oct 22 19:53" with a notification bell icon
- **Window Controls**: Minimize, Maximize, and Close buttons on the top-right corner
- **Application Name**: "LibreOffice Writer" displayed in the top-left corner

## Desktop Environment

- **Left Sidebar (Activities Panel)**: Contains application icons including:
  - Google Chrome
  - Thunderbird
  - Visual Studio Code
  - VLC Media Player
  - LibreOffice Writer (currently active)
  - LibreOffice Calc
  - LibreOffice Impress
  - GIMP
  - File Manager
  - Software Center
  - Help
  - Trash
- **Bottom Left Corner**: Grid icon for application launcher

## LibreOffice Writer Interface

### Menu Bar

- **Menu Items**: File, Edit, View, Insert, Format, Styles, Table, Form, Tools, Window, Help

### Toolbar

- **Standard Toolbar**: Contains icons for:
  - New Document
  - Open Document
  - Save Document
  - Print Document
  - Cut, Copy, Paste
  - Find and Replace
  - Font Selection
  - Text Formatting (Bold, Italic, Underline, Strikethrough)
  - Text Color
  - Font Size (12 pt)
  - Alignment (Left, Center, Right, Justify)
  - List Styles
  - Indentation
  - Page Break
  - Special Characters (Ω)
  - Link
  - Comment
  - Table
  - Drawing Tools

### Status Bar

- **Document Information**: "Page 1 of 1", "156 words, 1,140 characters"
- **Page Style**: "Default Page Style"
- **Language**: "English (USA)"
- **View Mode**: "Outline 1"
- **Zoom Level**: "104%"
- **Navigation Controls**: Page navigation buttons

### Notification Bar

- **Message 1**: "Help us make LibreOffice even better!" with a "Get involved" button
- **Message 2**: "Your donations support our worldwide community." with a "Donate" button

## Insert Section Dialog Box

### Dialog Title

- "Insert Section"

### Tab Navigation

- **Tabs**: Section, Columns, Indents, Area, Footnotes/Endnotes
- **Active Tab**: "Section" (highlighted in orange)

### Section Tab Content

#### New Section

- **Label**: "New Section"
- **Input Field**: Text box containing "Section1"

#### Link Section

- **Link Checkbox**: Unchecked
- **DDE Checkbox**: Unchecked
- **File Name Field**: Empty text box with "Browse..." button

#### Section Dropdown

- **Label**: "Section"
- **Dropdown Field**: Empty with dropdown arrow

#### Write Protection

- **Protect Checkbox**: Unchecked
- **With Password Checkbox**: Unchecked
- **Password Field**: "Password..." button

#### Hide Section

- **Hide Checkbox**: Unchecked
- **With Condition Field**: Empty text box

#### Properties

- **Editable in read-only document Checkbox**: Unchecked

### Dialog Buttons

- **Help Button**: Located at the bottom-left
- **Reset Button**: Located at the bottom-center
- **Cancel Button**: Located at the bottom-center
- **Insert Button**: Located at the bottom-right

## Sidebar Panel

- **Icons**: Various tools and functions including:
  - Text formatting
  - Styles
  - Document properties
  - Navigation
  - Search
  - Zoom

## Document Content Area

- **Document Title**: "nda_contract.odt"
- **Document Content**: Not visible due to the dialog box overlay
- **Document Status**: "Page 1 of 1" indicated in the status bar

## Document Statistics

- **Word Count**: 156 words
- **Character Count**: 1,140 characters

## Language Settings

- **Language**: English (USA)

## View Mode

- **Current View**: Outline 1

## Zoom Level

- **Current Zoom**: 104%

## Navigation Controls

- **Page Navigation**: Buttons for navigating through pages

## Document Properties

- **Page Style**: Default Page Style

## Document Status

- **Page Number**: Page 1 of 1

## Document Statistics

- **Word Count**: 156 words
- **Character Count**: 1,140 characters

## Document Language

- **Language**: English (USA)

## Document View

- **Current View**: Outline 1

## Document Zoom

- **Current Zoom**: 104%

## Document Navigation

- **Page Navigation**: Buttons for navigating through pages
